greeting: FRESH CATCH! Straight from the boat to YOU!
Barnacle-Bill's the name, seafood's the game!
You look hungry! Good! I've got JUST the thing!
Back for more? Knew you couldn't resist my clams!
Welcome to the fish market! Smell means FRESH!
New customer? First squid's on discount!
The ocean provides! And I sell what it provides!
Best seafood in Tide! Probably! Definitely top three!
dialog.seafood_offer: Got fish! Got shellfish! Got things with too many legs that TASTE GREAT!
dialog.freshness_guarantee: Caught this morning! Still smells like the sea! That's how you know it's GOOD!
dialog.brother_rivalry: My brother? Seaweed-Sam? Thinks plants are the future. HA! Fish is FOREVER!
dialog.pricing_philosophy: Fair prices! I catch it, I sell it, no middle-fish!
rumor: Something BIG is eating the deep catches. Bigger than a boat.
Tide fish taste better than Mire fish. Mire fish taste like... mud.
Frost has ICE fish. Frozen solid. What's the POINT?
Ember doesn't even HAVE fish. Just sad.
dialog.cooking_tips: Best way to cook? Grill it! With lemon! If you have lemon. If not, just grill it!
farewell: Come back when you're hungry! Which is ALWAYS!
Don't be a stranger! Be a CUSTOMER!
Safe travels! And bring a cooler next time!
dialog.time_dawn: Early market! First catch of the day!
dialog.time_noon: Lunch rush! Everyone wants my fish fry!
dialog.time_dusk: Evening sales! Last chance for freshness!
dialog.time_night: Closed! Fish sleeps! So do I!

party_reactions.kade: That's... a very enthusiastic fish salesman.
party_reactions.korr: Fresh seafood is a luxury. You price it fairly.
party_reactions.renna: Do you have any... magical fish? Enchanted? No?
party_reactions.sova: Fish is brain food. Need my brain sharp.
party_reactions.grit: Reminds me of field rations. Better smell, though.
party_reactions.ashka: Fish is... okay. Prefer red meat.
party_reactions.callum: Is it supposed to smell like that?

relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Back again! The fish called to you!
relationship_dialog.friend: My regular! Saved you the best cut!
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You! Family rates! Which means FREE samples!
